changelog:
- Initial release of incremental ROI tracking for AI agents.
- Logs time saved and direct cash value for each relevant delivery as they occur.
- Provides a simple ledger and monthly closeout process to summarize results.
- Generates an HTML dashboard for tracking trends and reporting results.
- All configuration and tracking data are saved in the workspace under `/reports/roi/`.
summary: Track your AI agent's ROI incrementally — log time saved and direct cash as deliveries happen, then close the cycle monthly with an HTML dashboard.
